name: codex-radar-provider
description: Offline-first Codex Radar data bridge for model capability and scheduling consumers.

interface.shortDescription: Offline-first radar data for model-aware routing.
interface.longDescription: Projects the upstream Codex Radar sync skill and defines a provider bridge contract for Workbench and DSH consumers. It preserves last-known-good observations, fails closed when data authorization or freshness is unavailable, and never treats Radar as live quota.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest offline Codex Radar snapshot.
Explain the provider contract for Workbench or DSH.
Check whether radar data is fresh and authorized.
